primary.title: The Foundations of Leninism
primary.author: Joseph Stalin
primary.rationale: A foundational text outlining Stalin's interpretation of Marxist-Leninist theory, widely disseminated and influential.

primary.title: Problems of Leninism
primary.author: Joseph Stalin
primary.rationale: An expanded work building upon 'The Foundations of Leninism,' further articulating Stalin's political and ideological positions.

primary.title: The Great Patriotic War of the Soviet Union
primary.author: Joseph Stalin
primary.rationale: A collection of speeches and orders during World War II, offering direct insight into his wartime leadership and propaganda.

secondary.title: Stalin: Paradoxes of Power, 1878-1953
secondary.author: Stephen Kotkin
secondary.rationale: A highly acclaimed and comprehensive biography that offers deep analysis of Stalin's life, rule, and impact.

secondary.title: Stalin: The Court of the Red Tsar
secondary.author: Simon Sebag Montefiore
secondary.rationale: Focuses on Stalin's inner circle and personal life, providing a detailed and often intimate portrait of his regime.

secondary.title: The Cambridge History of Russia: Volume 3, The Soviet Union, 1917-1991
secondary.author: Ronald Grigor Suny (editor)
secondary.rationale: Contains scholarly chapters by leading historians that analyze the Stalinist period within the broader context of Soviet history.

suggestions.notes: Primary source availability on Wikisource and Project Gutenberg for Stalin's works is limited, with Internet Archive being the most likely repository for his major writings and speeches.
